policy: No repair or mechanical service clip is published until its movement sequence, target components and exact hardware revision are reviewed. Viewer-only operating effects are educational and do not claim measured rpm, CFD or electrical simulation.

viewer_effects.description: Procedural rotation of both fan rotors; animation speed is a visual control, not an RPM readout.
Moving particles indicate conceptual airflow direction; no fluid simulation is performed.
Pulses show a schematic energy path, not PCB copper routes, pin mapping or current measurements.
